title: walmartAPI::lookup does not return json
description:
I was messing around with this wrapper and tried to use the lookup function. I have the following code:

```R
library(tidyverse) 
library(walmartAPI)
key <- "blahblah"
walmartAPI::save_walmart_credentials("blahblah")
walmartAPI::lookup(id = 43985582, key = key)
```
I always get the following error
Error: API did not return json

Is there something I'm doing wrong?
